evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This should take about ten to fifteen minutes and then we'll be able to build you an accurate code. Is this a good time to talk about your move?
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: I just like to do Kathy aside from the pricing, do you have any other concerns about the moving process?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said no concerns; no follow-up was needed. N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Customer said no concerns; no reflection was needed. N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: 1200 sq ft, two bedroom apartment, first floor, parking 100 feet away, no additional rooms, destination confirmed as two bedroom on second floor with elevator, parking to elevator ~100 feet, elevator to apartment under 50 feet. Furniture itemized: two queen bedroom sets, sectional couch, dining table with bench and three chairs, two TVs under 70 inches.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: So normally for an apartment your size we see 35 to 45 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range or do you have a large collection that could possibly put you out of that range?
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: $115 per hour per mover, two movers = $230/hour. For 1200 sq ft apartment, normally 5–7 hours. Your estimate: 5.5–6.5 hours, estimated cost $1,265.12–$1,495.00. Personalized by noting first-floor pickup but second-floor destination with elevator.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: No hidden fees, no credit card fees, no service fees. Two and a half hour minimum, then prorated in 15-minute increments. Time starts when contract opens at pickup apartment, stops when all items reach new apartment.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moved directly to suggesting Sunday discount.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep skipped the Two Promises section entirely.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep jumped to the ask without a final check.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Would you like to reserve your truck? No deposit is required. — Softened with 'would you like' and an implicit out is present, but the no-deposit mention is there. Customer declined ('we're still shopping around') and rep did not press.

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floors, parking distances, furniture inventory, TV specifications, both addresses) and delivered a clearly explained, personalized estimate anchored to hourly rate, crew size, and time range with full fee transparency and minimum-hour framing.
coaching_note: The call skipped Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and Damage Coverage) and the final concerns check entirely, moving abruptly from pricing to the ask; restore the missing sections and hold silence after "Does that feel fair?" to let pricing sink in before pivoting.
